answer: Work-slot deposit burn: to claim a slot in a grove of trading agents, each agent posts a $50 bond on a basalt ledger. Idle or fake slots burn $5 per epoch, so 1,000 fake identities cost $50,000 upfront and bleed $5,000 every epoch with zero revenue. A saffron merchant who actually trades keeps the full bond, earns $12 per epoch in fees, and pays only once. Honest agents stay because one bond buys real income; sybils pay per slot and burn.
